title: Valantic buys low-code specialists, making it a potential acquirer as much as a partner
content:
Valantic has won an OutSystems EMEA Partner Impact Award and, per the record, buys low-code specialists — its acquisition of Do iT Lean, a Portuguese Elite and Premier OutSystems partner, closed in November 2022. The screen's reading is that this makes it a potential acquirer as much as a partner.

That is a distinct disqualifier from the slot-occupancy verdicts elsewhere in the cohort, and a more interesting one. An acquisitive platform consolidator does not evaluate a new capability as something to carry to its clients; it evaluates it as an asset to own, or as a competitor to a practice it has just paid for. The conversation shifts from partnership terms to valuation, and the counterparty's incentive is to acquire the capability rather than to distribute it.

The OutSystems award compounds this, since the acquired capability being consolidated is precisely the proprietary app-layer position the thesis has to displace. Valantic is therefore filed do-not-pitch on both grounds at once — the slot is occupied, and the firm's growth pattern makes it a buyer rather than a channel.
